To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the land use/cover changes in Dhaka Metropolitan were mainly due to urban expansion and agricultural land conversion.

the land use/cover changes in Dhaka Metropolitan are rapid and significant and that the changes have occurred in the following ways: (1) the built-up area has been increasing at a rate of 2.2% per year; (2) the agricultural land has been decreasing at a rate of about 2.1% per year; and (3) wetlands/lowlands, water bodies and vegetation have been decreasing at rates of about 2% per year.
the urban expansion resulted in the considerable change in the land use and landcover in the study area.
